limitations: Wheel opening, paging, sector selection and confirmation use the named route. Keyboard and controller runs move focus only with arrows or the D-pad along the panel focus chain from the focus the game itself sets, then activate with Enter or A; pointer runs click, hover and scroll.
Dropdown rows (lot and history) are reached, cancelled and chosen with the same named route.
Focus loss is injected through the fixture hook; no OS focus or physical device is exercised.
Requests are session memory: their decline is attested by the probe and managed session tests, not by journal records.
Archive-only quote discovery is not surfaced by this UI; saved-record checks read live-segment outcomes.
No physical-device, OS-focus, multiplayer Wait, art, retained-save migration or production acceptance.
